caption: In an indoor billiards room with a blue wall reading SKI CLUB, a pool table is covered with scattered red and yellow interlocking bricks, several billiard balls, and a tall upright red brick column in the center. A woman in a blue striped shirt leans over the table holding a cue, her bridge hand resting near a short horizontal brick row. Four onlookers stand or sit around the table, watching the play, while the left red-and-yellow column, the large brick field on the right, and the tall central column remain essentially in place. The upright yellow brick column in the foreground topples and breaks apart into a flat scattered pile of loose bricks. The red ball at the base of the collapsing column moves and comes to rest a short distance to the right of the resulting pile. The woman's bent-over cue stance and the onlookers' poses remain largely static across the segment. The tall central red column remains upright and unchanged throughout the excerpt. The loose bricks settle without further visible disturbance.
